_meta.title: Compatibility long-form write-ups (Co-Star style)
_meta.model: function + your_line + their_line/same_sign_line + verdict; Moon and Venus are source-only authored compatibility libraries
_meta.note: Sign trait clauses condensed from Marie Satori, 'As Above, So Below' (2023) — her verbatim per-sign Moon/Mercury/Venus descriptions — plus cc-planet-in-sign-reviewed. Voiced-original condensations of her words; tier voiced-original-grounded, DRAFT pending sign-off. NOT served as verbatim Marie.

aries.function: The Sun is your essential self, your identity and the spirit you lead with. It shows how each of you shines and takes up space.
aries.your_line: You both have Sun in Aries, meaning your identity comes through bold and direct: you'd rather start something than wait to be asked, though you can act before you think and charge in on impulse.
aries.same_sign_line: You share the same core identity, so you recognize each other fast. You lead the same way and shine in the same kind of room, and you understand what drives the other without it being explained. The catch is that you also share the same blind spot, and neither of you brings an outside angle to it. Let each of you lead where you are genuinely strongest instead of competing for the same attention.
aries.verdict: You're cut from the same cloth, and the respect is real.
aries.synthesis: You can compete for the same spotlight instead of sharing it. Root for each other; there's room for two to shine.
aries.tier: descriptions = REVIEWED authored voice (natal_sign_story); their_line pronoun-shifted; synthesis/match voiced-original

taurus.function: The Sun is your essential self, your identity and the spirit you lead with. It shows how each of you shines and takes up space.
taurus.your_line: Your Sun is in Aries, meaning your identity comes through bold and direct: you'd rather start something than wait to be asked, though you can act before you think and charge in on impulse.
taurus.their_line: Their Sun is in Taurus, meaning they know who they are slowly and solidly, and they don't move until it feels worth it, though they can dig in and resist change until it costs they progress.
taurus.verdict: Your cores don't quite line up, but you can stretch each other.
taurus.synthesis: Your pace and priorities can fall out of step. Check what matters most to each of you this season.
taurus.tier: descriptions = REVIEWED authored voice (natal_sign_story); their_line pronoun-shifted; synthesis/match voiced-original

taurus.verdict: You handle limits and fear so differently it can wear on you.
taurus.synthesis: One tightens control while the other needs slack. Say what you each need to feel secure.
